purpose: Executive claim-to-evidence tracing; each classification is bounded by its stated scope.

claims.claim: Conventional foreground removal exposes a bounded opportunity, not a PointStream gain.
claims.scope: Eight 4K, 48-frame scenes from six matches; changed target and scene-level standard errors.
claims.contradiction_or_limit: Foreground reconstruction is unpaid; modular costs often exceed the remaining budget.

claims.claim: The saved Gate A candidate costs more than VVC over shared quality support; AV1 has no overlap.
claims.scope: Stored 192-frame, 24 fps, native 4K observations; arithmetic and source-file identity checked, with no frame/native recertification.
claims.contradiction_or_limit: No AV1 BD-rate; interpolation changes magnitude; no model-family claim.
claims.paper_use: Bounded historical curve with qualification attached

claims.claim: JE10’s nominal 309-byte margin does not establish an independently decoded complete-codec win.
claims.scope: 48-frame Alcaraz000 weighted regional quality and component arithmetic.
claims.contradiction_or_limit: Real color-component work survives; cached background/source tracks undermine the fresh-client claim; JE11 repeats costs rather than distinct intervals.

claims.claim: Manuscript victories and routing guarantees contain source and quality contradictions.
claims.scope: Mac, Overleaf and GPU3 commits and dirty text; unpublished UI state remains unknown.
claims.contradiction_or_limit: Dirty text withdraws claims. Its replacement report is recovered and arithmetic checked, but rate comparison remains withheld and receiver qualification missing.
claims.paper_use: Withdraw unsupported claims; reuse contracts and motivation

claims.claim: Several old model rankings were invalidated by conditioning and metric defects.
claims.scope: Named pre-repair LPIPS, VMAF, reference and model-call paths.
claims.contradiction_or_limit: Later repairs and specific qualified screens remain separate; the generation-disabled YOLO pilot is unaffected by AnimateAnyone defects.

claims.claim: Broad egocentric utility, rate and latency dominance is unqualified.
claims.scope: 133 pinned initial files plus nine close-out code/UI sources and saved reports.
claims.contradiction_or_limit: Some backend-explicit points are favorable; results vary by clip, and input identity, denominators, wire, rate and exposure are not uniformly qualified.
claims.paper_use: Separate task domain and concrete missing controls

claims.claim: Tennis and egocentric SAM work can share contracts and failure lessons, with domain-specific evidence.
claims.scope: Official tennis SAM 3.1 pilot and egocentric SAM 3 mislabel/integration state.
claims.contradiction_or_limit: Track coverage is not accuracy; racket views are quarantined; split and wire-parity gates remain; the egocentric model identity differs.
claims.paper_use: Shared methodology table with separate domain results

claims.claim: External generative-baseline intake is source/literature inspection rather than replication.
claims.scope: Existing GVC-RT, GLC-video and MTTF intake and bounded primary-source checks.
claims.contradiction_or_limit: Custom neural adaptations and foreground screens are actual work, with different scope from faithful whole-paper replications.
